title: The loaf and jug of bread and wine in Omar
html_source:
A famous line from the Rubaiyat of Omar Kayyam (1048-1131), a book of Persian poetry translated into English by Edward FitzGerald in 1849/1889:

“A Book of Verses underneath the Bough,
A Jug of Wine, a Loaf of Bread—and Thou
Beside me singing in the Wilderness—
Oh, Wilderness were Paradise enow!”
